title: Federal Campaign Financial Transparency Act
desc: Stricter limits should be placed on political fundraising, and anonymous 'dark money' donor pools should be completely banned.
for: Blocks wealthy donors from buying undue political influence.
against: Limits corporate and organizational free speech rights.

title: Handheld Cellular Driving Regulations Charter
desc: The federal government should establish mandatory national penalties for operating a mobile device while driving to reduce commuter collisions.
for: Significantly decreases traffic fatalities and distracted driving.
against: Infringes on personal freedoms and duplicates existing state laws.

title: Municipal Carbon Infrastructure Taxation Initiative
desc: Heavy corporate waste producers should pay penalty fees to reduce industrial pollution footprints.
for: Forces massive polluters to clean up their operations.
against: Increases production costs, which gets passed to consumers.

title: Carbon Tax on Imports
desc: The nation should enact tariff penalties on imported goods from countries that fail to meet baseline climate and environmental benchmarks.
for: Protects domestic clean manufacturing from cheap foreign polluters.
against: Can spark global trade retaliations and supply chain disruptions.

title: Federal Term Limits
desc: Constitutional rules should be amended to place term ceilings on Supreme Court justices and members of Congress instead of lifetime appointments.
for: Encourages dynamic, generational turnover and blocks career political corruption.
against: Loses experienced lawmakers and increases reliance on unelected lobbyists.

title: Campaign Finance Reform
desc: The government should implement stricter limits and greater transparency rules on all political campaign contributions and organizational expenditures.
for: Returns basic electoral power to individual, everyday citizens.
against: Restricts fundraising avenues required for competitive political outreach.

title: National Debt Resolution
desc: The federal government should implement structural spending caps and comprehensive tax audits to systematically reduce the national debt.
for: Restores long-term economic stability and stops inflation spirals.
against: Requires painful cuts to public programs or unpopular tax hikes.

title: Universal Healthcare Option
desc: The government should establish a universal public healthcare option to guarantee basic medical coverage and lower patient costs for all citizens.
for: Guarantees healthcare access for all income brackets and removes medical debt.
against: Significantly raises government spending and disrupts private insurance options.

title: Global Warming Mitigation
desc: The federal government should phase out fossil fuel subsidies and heavily fund renewable energy grids to combat rising global temperatures.
for: Reduces catastrophic climate risks and creates modern green energy jobs.
against: Hurts traditional energy sectors and raises short-term grid costs.

title: Artificial Intelligence Safety Standards
desc: Stricter federal regulations and algorithmic audit parameters should be enforced on artificial intelligence developers to protect data privacy and jobs.
for: Prevents corporate data misuse, job displacements, and deepfake misinformation.
against: Stifles global technological innovation and hampers startup businesses.

title: Wealth Gap Mitigation
desc: Federal tax brackets should be reorganized to increase taxes on extreme wealth and capital gains to fund middle-class social mobility programs.
for: Balances growing financial inequality and builds stronger communities.
against: Discourages wealth accumulation and can cause investment capital flight.

title: Trump Administration Political Legacy Evaluation
desc: The 'America First' policy framework, characterized by strict border control and deregulation, remains the ideal blueprint for future administrations.
for: Prioritizes domestic economic growth, industrial jobs, and strong borders.
against: Weakens international alliances and stalls vital climate initiatives.

title: Foreign Affairs Alliances
desc: The United States should restrict its military interventions abroad and focus its foreign resources strictly on securing local democratic trade alliances.
for: Saves billions in taxpayer funds and prevents messy proxy conflicts.
against: Creates global power vacuums that can be filled by aggressive foreign adversaries.

title: Education Funding Reallocation
desc: The federal government should establish public school voucher systems, letting parents direct public funding to private or charter institutions.
for: Empowers parents with choices and introduces healthy academic competition.
against: Drains vital resource funding from already underfunded public school systems.

title: Energy Grid Modernization
desc: Nuclear power infrastructure development should be heavily expanded to guarantee domestic clean energy independence alongside solar and wind systems.
for: Provides massive, reliable zero-emission baseline power to support grids.
against: Presents long-term radioactive waste management and facility security challenges.

title: Gun Control Legislation
desc: Federal background checks should be mandatory for all firearm sales, including red-flag laws that restrict access for high-risk individuals.
for: Reduces gun violence and blocks firearm access for dangerous actors.
against: Infringes on the constitutional rights of law-abiding citizens.

title: Immigration Processing Reform
desc: Border enforcement resources should be balanced with expanded legal asylum processing networks to solve humanitarian port backlogs.
for: Creates orderly border controls while preserving basic human dignity.
against: Encourages larger migration waves and strains municipal safety nets.

title: Social Media Algorithmic Accountability
desc: Social media platforms should face legal liabilities for failing to filter toxic algorithms that actively harm youth mental health.
for: Holds tech giants accountable for targeted addictive programming.
against: Creates severe free speech censorship risks across open web networks.

title: Tariff Application Enforcement
desc: Broad import tariffs should be permanently sustained on foreign manufacturing competitors to force corporations to rebuild supply chains domestically.
for: Brings manufacturing jobs back and protects domestic industries.
against: Triggers immediate consumer price spikes and sparks inflation loops.

title: Fiscal Responsibility and Congressional Accountability Act
desc: When the federal government fails to maintain a balanced budget by the end of a fiscal year, all sitting members of Congress shall be immediately ineligible for reelection.
for: Creates ultimate personal accountability for lawmakers and fixes spending incentives.
against: Could force extreme, sudden cuts to public programs during national downturns.
